findings.title: Side-effecting methods inherit presentation-read exemption
findings.mechanism: !write && !authorityRead classifies provider.probe and workspace.register as presentation reads; neither reserves write sequence nor write barrier, so Main authority scope completes while such an operation is queued/in-flight

build_assessment: Full 6444 input hashes match and exact3 bytes equal frozen HEAD blobs. Existing dirty precommit build is usable as byte-bound fixture evidence only, metadata remains C381 dirty; Source is rejected for R1; subsequent repaired Root package must be freshly rebuilt and honestly component-bound.
reverse_order_assessment: Single production createTransport serializes queued successful HTTP completion. Author dual-instance inversion is supplemental IPC robustness. Independent tests cover display-first while authority waits for credential using one real transport, and single-lane latest-ticket rejection.
